description: Emit a Recibo por Honorarios Electronico (RHE) via SUNAT SOL

empresa.description: Company or person name receiving the service

tipoDoc.description: Verified recipient path. RUC and DNI require a separate validation transition not present in the captured flow.

descripcion.description: Service description (e.g. 'Servicios de desarrollo de software')

monto.description: Total amount. If moneda=USD, will be converted to PEN at SUNAT exchange rate.

moneda.description: Currency. PEN was present in the captured flow; reconcile USD with --preview-only before live use.

fechaEmision.description: Emission date. The observed portal accepts today or the previous 2 days.

flags.--dry-run: Validate and print the payload without opening SUNAT
flags.--preview-only: Fill SUNAT, reconcile the rendered preview, and stop before Emitir Recibo
flags.--yes --live-sunat: Required together to invoke the production submission
flags.--batch <file>: Validate multiple RHEs from CSV with --dry-run; live batches are disabled

auth: Requires SOL session. Run 'sunat-cli login' first.
